name: Christian Service
overview: Christian service is portrayed in Scripture as a loving and active expression of faith, where believers are called to use their God-given gifts to support and serve others. The call to serve is grounded in Christ's teaching that it is more blessed to give than to receive, urging believers to bear one another's burdens and minister to the weak with selflessness. Serving others is not merely a duty but an outflow of love, performed with perseverance and faith, promising spiritual reward and illumination even in difficult circumstances.
